name: social-media-content-calendar
rationale: Preparing parent-facing content calendars is an explicit responsibility, while publishing is outside this profile's authority. No installed skill provides a calendar workflow that ties every post to an objective and metric, inventories verified claims and testimonial permissions, adapts briefs by channel, and distinguishes drafts, approvals, handoffs, and verified publication. This official optional Hermes skill fits that gap and can be run in draft-only mode.
risks: The skill includes scheduling and publishing branches; for this profile it must remain in draft or approval-handoff mode because posting and account actions require Lior's explicit approval.

Its recommended related humanizer skill is not installed in this profile; Hebrew warmth, RTL correctness, and parent-facing voice must instead be checked against the project's binding brand source and by the appropriate human or UX owner.
Platform cadence examples are generic; a capacity-constrained tutoring business should keep volume low and tie each slot to suitable-family demand rather than maximizing reach.
summary: Produces objective-linked, platform-specific content calendars with claim, permission, accessibility, approval, and publishing-status controls.
